# prescribed conduct

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:prescribedConduct`](gmeow-prescribedConduct.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/prescribedConduct>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)

The conduct the norm is about — an event type, a goal, a situation, or a rights action (via the graft). The range is intentionally open (the [`tenurePosition`](gmeow-tenurePosition.md) precedent): asserting a closed range union would either dangle across module boundaries or vanish from the generated schema surface, and the graft would force dual-typing of the [`RightsAction`](../classes/gmeow-RightsAction.md) vocabulary. NOT functional: one norm may govern several conducts jointly.
